descriptionChirho: The proper noun Elnathan (אֶלְנָתָן), referring to individuals in the Hebrew Bible, notably Elnathan son of Achbor (Jer 26:22, 36:12,25) and post-exilic leaders (Ezra 8:16). All occurrences across languages uniformly render this as a personal name: eng 'Elnatan/Elnathan', spa 'Elnatán/Elnatan', hin 'एलनातान/एल्नातान', arb 'إِلْنَاثَانَ/أَلْنَاثَان', kor '엘나탄/엨나탄', swa 'Elnathani/Elnatani'. The two clusters differ only in the presence or absence of the conjunctive waw prefix (וְ), which is a grammatical particle and not a semantic distinction.
